model: known-density flat 2+1 Minkowski, complete exact causal order

selection.rule: retain old selected root, support and first three landmarks on A; select the fourth using A only, minimum inherited full16/half4 counts and causal comparability to all required endpoints; minimize difference-Gram condition, marks break ties; no retries using B

count_covariance: Original overlap matrices retained in data and baseline. Candidate uses marginal Poisson composite objective, NOT joint likelihood; replicate experiments preserve correlations. No candidate covariance or coverage claim.
propagation: No candidate analytic covariance. Conditional repeat variance is descriptive only; active order constraints and nonlinear fits invalidate naive Hessian covariance.
negative_control: replace interval-count covariance by its diagonal before propagation
comparison: Joint four-landmark raw-count composite Poisson fit versus unchanged four-landmark inversion, identical selected A nodes and independent B counts; three-landmark baseline also reported.
qualification: min counts, valid initialization; optimizer success; complete directed order, constraints; original Gram signature/condition and moment solve; no recovery of count or initial signature failures.
gate_scope: All gates required for DEVELOPMENT_CANDIDATE_SUPPORTED only, never production/physics qualification. Complete 32 fresh A attempts and 9 B replicates per available A; no replacement, no tuning, no continuation after budget. Archived 18 B0 cases are separate descriptive development replay.
freeze: local code/input hash and UTC timestamp before first new A or B cloud
policy: one start from unchanged four inversion, joint all-node coordinates in canonical Minkowski gauge, same four-input interval mask; all pair orders constrained with fixed positive margins; raw marginal Poisson deviance; no field/truth input.
nonclaims: No independent validation from enforced order
